Selected work 01

Smartwatch for dyslexic children

An audio-first, icon-led, haptic watch interface for children with dyslexia in an Indian context.

Read the case study →

Thinking

Every project has a decision log.

One entry, from the smartwatch project.

Decision
Audio comes first. Text is the fallback.
Reason
On a watch-sized screen, reading is the barrier. Sound and haptics carry the instruction instead.
Trade-off
It fails in quiet places. The haptic-only mode still needs testing.
